nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic/implementation contract.
Sets the logic address and delegatecalls initialization calldata.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls all calldata to the logic contract.
Assembly delegatecall from fallback to _impl forwarding calldata.
Constructor parameter for the logic contract address.
Constructor parameter calldata passed to logic initialization.
Success flag returned by constructor delegatecall.
Raw return data returned by constructor delegatecall.
Local copy of logic address used in fallback.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _logic is assigned to immutable state variable logic.
_logic is the target address for the constructor delegatecall.
_initializationCalldata is passed as calldata to the constructor delegatecall.
Constructor executes the delegatecall initialization operation.
Fallback reads immutable logic state variable into local _impl.
_impl is the target address for the fallback delegatecall.
Fallback executes the assembly delegatecall operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _logic directly feeds the constructor delegatecall target; merge into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Constructor parameter _initializationCalldata directly feeds the constructor delegatecall calldata; merge into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Local _ok is the success result of the constructor delegatecall; merge into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Local returnData is the raw result of the constructor delegatecall; merge into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
Local _impl is the fallback delegatecall target; merge into the unsafe delegatecall operation.
